audience: operations teams that publish incidents and maintenance on StatusPage.me status pages

useCases.title: Check which status pages have open incidents
useCases.text: List the status pages of the account, then list the incidents of one page, newest first.

useCases.title: Review the uptime of a monitor
useCases.text: List the monitors with their current state, then read the availability figures of one monitor for a period.

useCases.title: Post an incident on a status page
useCases.text: Create an incident, or add a timeline update to one. It appears on the public page at once. Subscribers get a message only if notify_subscribers is true.

useCases.title: Schedule or change a maintenance window
useCases.text: Schedule a maintenance window with start and end times, or change its title, times or affected items later.

useCases.title: Read scheduled and past maintenance
useCases.text: List the maintenance windows of a status page, then read one of them.
